categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the research, design, and sales of high-performance analog integrated circuit chips, primarily divided into signal chain analog chips and power management analog chips. These products are widely applied in mobile phones, computers, automotive electronics, servers, smart wearables, smart home appliances, communication equipment, robotics, and security fields. The product portfolio includes over 1,800 models covering various categories such as high-performance analog switches, ultra-low power and high-precision operational amplifiers, multi-channel LDOs, and high-efficiency power management components.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced analog chip design technologies with mature 130/180nm BCD MOS processes and proprietary device and process know-how. Key technologies include ultra-low parasitic capacitance ESD structures, high-voltage MOS devices, high-bandwidth switch architectures up to 11GHz, low-power high-precision operational amplifiers, and advanced power management control circuits. The company follows a fabless model, outsourcing wafer fabrication and packaging/testing to leading foundries and packaging firms, while focusing on R&D, design, and sales.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic and international brands in consumer electronics (e.g., OPPO, Xiaomi, Vivo, Samsung), automotive electronics, servers, AI terminals, robotics, industrial control, and security sectors. The company serves a broad market with products integrated into smartphones, AI PCs, AI phones, AI glasses, servers, solid-state drives, and automotive lighting and motor control systems. It maintains stable partnerships with major electronic component distributors and top-tier end customers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Jiangsu and offices in Shanghai. It has wholly-owned subsidiaries in Hong Kong, the United States, Taiwan, South Korea, and Singapore, supporting sales and technical services. Its products are sold domestically and internationally, with significant revenue from both domestic and overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as a fabless semiconductor design firm, focusing on chip design and sales while outsourcing wafer fabrication to foundries such as DB HiTek and Hejian Chip Manufacturing, and packaging/testing to companies like Tongfu Microelectronics and Changdian Technology. It maintains long-term stable relationships with suppliers and integrates upstream and downstream resources to optimize product performance and quality.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous R&D investment to expand product lines and improve performance, focusing on high-speed, high-precision analog chips and power management solutions. The company emphasizes innovation in automotive electronics, AI applications, robotics, and server markets. It is advancing 12-inch wafer and 90nm BCD process technologies, developing differentiated device IPs, and enhancing intelligent power device capabilities. Talent development and intellectual property protection are also key focus areas.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of analog integrated circuits. The company employs a sales model dominated by buyout distribution complemented by direct sales. Revenue recognition occurs upon customer receipt of goods, confirmed by logistics and customer acceptance. The company also earns investment income from financial assets and equity investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the analog semiconductor market dominated globally by firms like Texas Instruments, Analog Devices, Infineon, and STMicroelectronics. While international giants hold over 80% market share, the company positions itself as a leading domestic analog chip supplier with a comprehensive product portfolio and growing market share in China’s expanding semiconductor market. It focuses on innovation and localization to narrow the gap with global leaders.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 526 million, a 38% increase year-over-year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 47 million. R&D expenses increased by 43%, accounting for nearly 40% of revenue, reflecting strong investment in innovation. The company’s total assets were about RMB 2.9 billion, with equity attributable to shareholders around RMB 2.75 billion. Despite recent losses, the company shows a growth trajectory supported by expanding sales and R&D capabilities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-performance, low-power, and high-reliability analog chip solutions tailored for diverse applications including AI, automotive, and consumer electronics. Its products feature advanced technologies such as ultra-low parasitic capacitance, high bandwidth, and integrated protection mechanisms, offering superior signal integrity and power efficiency. The company’s comprehensive product line and strong R&D capabilities enable rapid response to market needs and customization, positioning it as a competitive and innovative domestic supplier in the analog semiconductor industry.
